in_marathi.name: Tribhuwan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of three worlds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tribhuwan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name that signifies the ruler of three worlds: the physical world, the spiritual world, and the world of ancestors. In Hindu mythology, Tribhuvan is the name of several gods, including Lord Vishnu, Lord Shiva, and Lord Brahma.
